intro: Every line that can appear on a payslip. Codes are what the payroll engine matches on, so treat them as identifiers rather than labels.
emptyDescription: Start with the earnings you actually pay — BASIC and HRA are usually first. Statutory deductions (TDS, PF, ESI, PT) are created by payroll itself, so you don't need to add them.
glTooltip: Where this component posts in the accounting journal; blank uses the default for its type
